rĕcorpŏrātĭo , ōnis, f. recorporo, a
I.furnishing again with a body or flesh; the restoration of the body to its former state (post-class.), Tert. Res. Carn. 30; Cael. Aur. Tard. 1 prooem.; 1, 4, 112.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
